status: development-shadow-only; no live cache, context extension, or promotion claim

payload.objective: Test whether ATXY-addressed KV pages can carry a separately validated per-layer/per-KV-head linear latent before any codebook or routing experiment.

fit.key_basis: For each layer/KV head: eigendecompose 0.5 times mean uncentered post-RoPE K second moment plus 0.5 times mean uncentered post-RoPE Q second moment across its two GQA query heads.
fit.value_basis: For each layer/KV head: centered PCA with one retained float32 value mean.
fit.rank_nesting: Fit once at rank 128 and use leading prefixes without refitting.

payload.decision_rule: A joint arm passes only if its dimensional 40,960-token net ratio and every quality threshold pass both overall and in each selected layer. Passing authorizes only a separately versioned ATXY latent-codebook experiment, never a live cache or context extension.

implementation.postflight_requirement: Every src/molor Python byte must match preflight before report creation.

codec.equation: K basis = eig(0.5 mean(KK') + 0.5 mean(QQ')); V = centered local PCA

atxy_page_identity.role: exact physical page identity only; not a semantic hash or latent code

limitations: Only layers 0, 13, and 27 and one file-disjoint 4K held-out context are measured.
The 40,960-token result is dimensional storage arithmetic, not a long-context quality run.
No live cache, GPU latent kernel, codebook, hash router, TTL, or context-position extension is installed.
Passing permits only a separately versioned latent-codebook experiment; it cannot promote a cache.
